content.comment_body: Is there a way to expand the workspace in the FBD editor of [product_name]? I seem to be running out of space, but I have more ideas for new features.
No, it's not possible to increase the program memory.
Are you asking about getting more space on the screen for your program? If yes, you can use the 'Page Layout' button to add more pages.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces limitations with the workspace size in the FBD editor of [product_name] and feels restricted when attempting to expand their project. There is confusion between program memory constraints and expanding the visual workspace, leading to a sense of limited creative possibilities due to either interface or memory limits.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to have the ability to expand both the visual workspace and program memory in [product_name] for the development of more complex and feature-rich projects.
